messages:
clare: Quick question: before we start a route attr split, can we settle on what the canonical route_group derivation is? Different services derive it slightly differently (hash vs prefix bucket). We need one canonical algorithm for partitioning and quota mapping.

dan: we should use the hashing scheme that aligns with routing policy sharding (consistent hashing mod N). prefix buckets were an ad-hoc optimization and have caused misalignment.

vik: agree on consistent hashing but add a stable salt/version in derivation so we can bump in future with migration plan. We'll store derivation_version in event_meta.

clare: will update the adapters. also add a compatibility header so older clients that don't send derivation_version default to v1 behavior.

infra-bot: migration-checker: detected no blocking schema conflicts for planned column addition event_meta.derivation_version.

dan: excellent. let's add a small test harness that verifies mapping of 10k route_ids -> route_group both old and new algos and assert <0.01% divergence for top 1000.

clare: I'll coordinate with QA to run that. Keeping derivation stable is critical for quota consistency during dual-write.

vik: note for runbook: derive_version moves into audit logs. practice: do not change salt without a full roll-back plan.

clare: done. PR coming in for adapters and doc update.
